claims: Mortgage loan officers act as the intermediary between borrowers and lenders.
Mortgage loan officers must register with the Nationwide Multistate Licensing System (NMLS).
Mortgage loan officers must pass the SAFE MLO test.
A high school diploma is generally required for mortgage loan officers.
A bachelor's degree in finance or business is preferred by many employers for mortgage loan officers.
Background checks are standard requirements for mortgage loan officers.
Credit reports are standard requirements for mortgage loan officers.
Pre-licensing education is standard for mortgage loan officers.
Mortgage loan officers gather financial documents including income, debts, and credit reports.
In some reports, average earnings of mortgage loan officers reach over $180,000 yearly.
Top earners among mortgage loan officers make over $180,000.
Mortgage loan officers require understanding of credit reports, debt-to-income ratios, and tax documents.
Mortgage loan officers are involved in both residential and commercial real estate.
